root_cause: The datepicker updates the visible input's value to a locale-specific format (e.g., MM/DD/YYYY) during initialization, causing form submission to use this format instead of the expected ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).
repair_strategy: For non-inline datepickers attached to input elements, create a hidden input sibling to hold the actual value (in ISO format via joined selectedDates) and remove the name from the visible input so only the hidden input is submitted. The visible input retains the locale-formatted date for usability.
expected_accessibility_effect: No change to accessibility as accessible names/roles remain intact; visible input stays focusable and labeled, hidden input is not exposed to assistive technology.
functional_risks: Client-side validation/scripting relying on visible input's value may break due to locale format
Multiple selection mode may produce comma-separated ISO dates unexpected by server
Duplicate name attributes possible if other elements share the same name (mitigated by moving name to hidden input)
verification_requirements: Form submission includes departure date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD)
Visible input shows locale-formatted date (e.g., MM/DD/YYYY for en-US)
Datepicker updates both inputs correctly when a date is selected
